item.title: Comment on 50 Takes from Kevin Bryan by H
item.description:
People overrate demographics. Population size hasn’t mattered much since Cortez and Pizarro conquered whole empires with a couple hundred guys. Superior technologies win over larger populations. I don’t think Africa will be the future regardless of population growth, and population decline will not be a problem for Europe and Asia if they manage to keep up with technology—falling behind the US in things like AI is a much bigger risk.
